dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains information on the rates and time limits for parking meters in the City. Information is shown at the block level rather than for the individual meter.

Data currency

This data in City systems is updated in the normal course of business, however priorities and resources determine how fast a change in reality is reflected in the database. The extract on this web site is updated weekly.

Data accuracy

Locations are shown for entire block faces however that does not mean that there are parking meters along the entire block face.
